### ✨ Neverness to Everness Mod Menu (v1.5.0)
Pro Glass UI Mod Menu for **Neverness to Everness** by **m0hammed** (`@m0hmm3d`) — supports both **Rootless (`arm64`)** and **RootHide (`arm64e`)**.

### 🔥 Mod Features
- **God Mode** — Block all incoming damage & prevent character death
- **One-Hit Kill** — Deal instant lethal damage to enemies
- **Oracle Stone Auto-Open** — Maximizes Oracle Stone open/pickup radius & auto-triggers
- **Gift & Treasure Auto-Unlock** — Bypasses chest locks & auto-opens Gift/Treasure boxes
- **Auto Collapse Magic Boxes** — Instantly solves & collapses Magic Box puzzles
- **5x Multi Magic Spin** — Triggers `5x` rapid spins per Magic Spin start request
- **Auto Claim Bank Awards** — Automatically requests Score, Quest & Manual Bank awards
- **Claim All Bank Awards & Quests** — 1-Tap claim for all Bank Heist rewards

### 🛡️ Protection
- **1-User License**: Each token locks automatically to the first device that activates it.
